role: Business Intelligence Engineer, Innovation and Design Engineering
responsibilities: You will be working with massive-scale data and providing analytic support to product managers and engineering peers using this data.
You will utilize your deep expertise in business analysis, metrics, reporting, and analytic tooling/languages like SQL, Excel, and others, to translate the data into meaningful insights.
You will have ownership of the insights you are building for the business, and will play an integral role in tactical decision-making for machine and process design.

evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: An understanding of design for scalability, performance and reliability.
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Reliability, anomaly detection and accuracy appear with no speed phrases, so the tie-breaker gives rigour.
evidence.domain_risk: transforming it into useful automation insights such as Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE)
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: Operational automation insights inform design decisions without regulatory or financial reporting language, so it is moderate.
evidence.collaboration_width: product managers; engineering peers; controls engineers
evidence.data_team_maturity: a cross-functional team of mechatronic engineers, controls engineers, data engineers, and simulation scientists
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: Amazon-scale data with data engineers and simulation scientists already in the team points to a mature setup.
evidence.jd_authorship: analyzing performance metrics from a new robotic storage system in the morning
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: The day-in-the-life section names OEE, robotic storage and throughput data, so a reader knows the work.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: providing analytic support to product managers and engineering peers
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The audience is product managers and engineers designing automation systems, so it is product.
evidence.autonomy_level: You will have ownership of the insights you are building for the business
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: The role owns its insights but also provides analytic support to engineering, so it is mixed.
evidence.ai_role_explanation: No AI skill is expected of the candidate.
evidence.testing_framing: coding standards, code reviews, source management, build processes, testing, and operations
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Testing appears only in a preferred list of software practices, so it is tool_listed.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: The posting is framed around insight and innovation, with no data risk register.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: New analyses for new systems sit alongside automated dashboards over existing data, so it is mixed.
